text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and I are heading back
from a day
out, when...
Whoops, I just remembered something!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teach, if you've got time, can we
add one
more thing to our to-do list?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
A-as in our plans, not a fight! See, I've
got two
tickets for a museum to use up...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know, I know. That's what I said
too, but
the owner of a shop I visit a lot
insisted on giving
them to me.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It would've been rude to keep refusing
their good
will, so I caved.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I thought you'd know more
about artsy
stuff than me, so wanna go?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm not that clued up about art either,
but we end
up going to the museum
together.
Whoa... This place is huge.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Check this out, Teach. It's a sculpture of
an
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: It's called The Sprinting Umamusume. She definitely looks like she's about to take off!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Look, there's even a statue of a human!
They're so
muscular and realistic, I
wouldn't be surprised if
they started
moving.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Whoever made these really went all out.
It's got
me itchin' to take on a challenge
myself!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I mean, you'd need some real
observational skills
and grit to do this.
Man, art is amazing.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
We take our time walking through the
museum.
Hishi Amazon is thoroughly
impressed by the art.

Phew... That installation was somethin'
else.
Everything had some real oomph!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm not really good with complicated
things... but
I seriously dig how
passionate these artists are!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for tagging along, Teach.
Otherwise, I
probably would have
passed up the place without
givin' it a
chance.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
But since you were with me, I had a
great time!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list: Let's make your running an inspiration to artists.

text_block_list.text:
Me, inspiring artists? I never thought of
that, but
I like it.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
All right! I've gotta show off the new
passion I feel
for art in my next run!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That'll be my way of supporting artists
and their
work!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It'd be cool if someone made a real work
of art
after seein' me run!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Well, this is no time to be standin' still!
Let's hurry
back and get to training!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Come on! Time to run back to the
academy!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You're right. Having a lot of experiences
under
my belt will definitely come in
handy.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm no good at studying, but I know how
to think
with my heart. Plus, I can learn
using my five
senses!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hm? I'm smelling something good comin'
from
over there. Time to trust this nose
of mine!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and I walk over to the
museum cafe
together.

Whoa, check out this monster stack of
pancakes.
Looks like they've recreated
some of the art
pieces on them with
chocolate.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I could make these as snacks for my
dorm
residents, or pack them as dessert
for their lunch.
Nothing like firsthand
experience to get inspired,
eh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
Oh yeah, making cute box lunches is kinda your
thing, huh?

text_block_list.text:
That's right. Hey, you know what? I'll
pack a lunch
for you sometime as thanks
for your hard work.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Culinary art is art too, after all. And I
guarantee
it'll taste as good as it looks!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I watch Хиши Амадзон's figure disappear
as she
sprints off into the distance. We
leave the
museum with a new dream in
tow.
